subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be narrowed to docs/help for the existing `pi-tui` newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a public configurable send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed multiline input, but adding an OpenClaw preference would create a new public config/CLI surface under a repository policy that keeps the config bar high.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update the TUI docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J/fallback behavior and defer configurable keybindings to a separately approved config decision.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Expose a public config or CLI bridge into `pi-tui` keybindings with focused fresh-install and upgrade/default tests.

options.title: Close As Implemented
options.body: Treat dependency-backed multiline composition as sufficient and close without adding docs/help or a new preference.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update the TUI docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J/fallback behavior and defer configurable keybindings to a separately approved config decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter provided the prior maintainer-style scope review and is the clearest current routing candidate for the docs-versus-config product call.
